faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: To book an appointment, open Appointments, choose your preferred haircut or service, select a barber, pick an available date on the calendar, then choose a time slot and confirm your booking.

faqs.question: How do I cancel an appointment?
faqs.answer: Open Appointments, tap the appointment you want to cancel, and use the cancel option on the detail screen. Cancellation rules may apply depending on payment and timing, so check the confirmation message before you confirm.

faqs.question: How do I reschedule an appointment?
faqs.answer: Open Appointments, tap Reschedule on a paid booking, then choose a new date and available time slot. You can reschedule up to 3 times, and changes must be made at least 24 hours before your appointment. Your previous slot becomes available for others.

faqs.question: What do appointment statuses mean?
faqs.answer: Appointment statuses show where your booking is in the process: pending or awaiting payment, confirmed after payment, completed after your visit, or cancelled if the booking was removed. Check Appointments for the latest status and details.

faqs.question: How does payment work?
faqs.answer: Service prices appear when you choose a haircut and barber during booking. Complete payment in the app after selecting your time slot. Your appointment is confirmed once payment succeeds.

faqs.question: What haircuts and services are available?
faqs.answer: Browse the Library or start booking to see available haircuts and services. Each style includes details, photos, and compatibility hints based on your face scan when available.

faqs.question: How do I choose a barber?
faqs.answer: During booking, you can choose from available barbers and see open time slots for each one. Pick the barber and schedule that work best for you before confirming payment.

faqs.question: What are your operating hours?
faqs.answer: Operating hours depend on the day, barber availability, and shop closures. The booking calendar shows live open dates and slots. For same-day questions, ask the front desk when you arrive.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are welcome when capacity allows. Use the kiosk or reception queue for regular or exclusive services. You can see your place in line and when a barber can start.

faqs.question: How does AI Face Scan work?
faqs.answer: AI Face Scan captures front, left, and right photos of your face. The app analyzes your face shape and hair length, then uses that to improve style recommendations and AI previews.

faqs.question: How do haircut recommendations work?
faqs.answer: After a successful face scan, the app recommends styles that fit your face shape and hair texture. Library cards and booking show Recommended, Possible, or Not Recommended badges so you can choose confidently.

faqs.question: How do AI hairstyle previews work?
faqs.answer: After your face scan, tap a hairstyle to generate an AI preview of how it may look on you. Generation can take a little time. Previously generated previews for the same style are reused so you do not need to generate again.

faqs.question: Are there limits on AI preview generation?
faqs.answer: AI preview generation has a limit on how many different styles you can generate per scan session. Regenerating or viewing a preview you already created for the same style does not use an extra generation.

faqs.question: What is the hairstyle Library?
faqs.answer: The Library is where you browse all available hairstyles with photos and descriptions. Search by name and use compatibility badges from your latest face scan to find styles that suit you.

faqs.question: How do Saved Haircuts work?
faqs.answer: When you save a hairstyle from the Library or detail page, it appears under Saved Haircuts. Open it anytime to review styles you liked before booking or generating a preview.

faqs.question: How do notifications work?
faqs.answer: Notifications keep you updated on appointments, booking changes, and important app messages. Open the bell icon in the top bar to view them and mark all as read when you are caught up.

faqs.question: How do I update my profile?
faqs.answer: Open Profile from the menu or top bar. You can update your name, phone, gender, hair texture, and profile photo, then tap Save Changes. Hair texture helps personalize recommendations.

faqs.question: I have password or sign-in problems
faqs.answer: If you cannot sign in, use the password reset option on the login screen or sign in again with Google if your account is linked. For persistent account issues, contact shop staff or support with the email on your account.

faqs.question: Why does hair texture matter?
faqs.answer: Set your hair texture in Profile as Straight, Wavy, or Curly. Recommendations and Library filtering use this to show styles that work better with your natural hair.

faqs.question: Where is the barbershop located?
faqs.answer: Visit Tati's Barbershop at the location shown on your booking confirmation, shop signage, or front desk. Ask staff if you need directions when you arrive.

faqs.question: What can you help me with?
faqs.answer: I can help with booking, rescheduling, payments, barbers, walk-ins, hours, AI Face Scan, hairstyle recommendations, AI previews, the Library, Saved Haircuts, notifications, and your profile. Ask me anything about the app.
